action_instruction: Waiting for finishing inspecting the available-flights results table
intent: PRIMARY: finish inspecting the available-flights results table; role=table; text="Flights from São Paolo to New York" | HINTS: container=main page results section
rationale: The results table and all five Choose This Flight rows are visible and inspected.

action_instruction: Checking the available-flights table column set
intent: whether the available-flights table provides the Airline, Flight #, departure-time, arrival-time, and Price columns

action_params.condition: The available-flights table columns are Airline, Flight #, Departure Time, Arrival Time, and Price.
action_params.query: whether the available-flights table provides the Airline, Flight #, departure-time, arrival-time, and Price columns
action_params.code_js: ['Airline','Flight #','Departure Time','Arrival Time','Price'].every(name => Array.from(el(6).querySelectorAll('th')).some(th => { const text = th.textContent.trim(); return text === name || (name === 'Departure Time' && text.startsWith('Departs:')) || (name === 'Arrival Time' && text.startsWith('Arrives:')); }))

action_instruction: Checking Choose This Flight actions in all listed results
intent: whether every listed available-flight result row provides a Choose This Flight action

action_params.condition: Each listed result row offers a "Choose This Flight" action.
action_params.query: whether every listed available-flight result row provides a Choose This Flight action

assertion_tree.description: the table columns are Airline, Flight #, Departure Time, Arrival Time, and Price, and each listed result row offers a "Choose This Flight" action.
